title: Least Squares MicroSim
description: An interactive simulation demonstrating how the least-squares algorithm works, with sliders for controlling slope and intercept to minimize squared residuals
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: linear regression
least squares
slope
intercept
residuals
data science
statistics
learningObjectives: Explain how a residual is the vertical distance between a data point and the fitted line, and why least squares minimizes the sum of squared residuals
Adjust the slope and intercept sliders to reduce the total squared error and find a best-fit line for the plotted points
Interpret the colored squares drawn on each residual as the geometric meaning of squared error
Describe how changing slope m and intercept b in y = mx + b moves the line relative to the data
Evaluate whether a manually fitted line is close to optimal by comparing its total squared error to the minimum achieved
